raw.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric_path = 'constant_fraction_fit.r2' THEN m.value_num END) as image_rate_r2, MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric_path = 'gen_signal.constant_fraction_vs_req.r2' THEN m.value_num END) as decode_demand_r2 FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric m ON d.run_id = m.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true AND m.stat = 'r2'
raw.claimed: R^2=0.123 of the image-rate series but R^2=0.654 of decode demand
raw.evidence: Constant-fraction model explains R^2 = 0.1225 (rounds to 0.123) of the image-rate series and R^2 = 0.6535 (rounds to 0.654) of decode demand variance.
